snippet.title: DKC4 - Greenleaf Grove
snippet.description:
This level was initially developed to be the first level of the final version of the fan gamez Donkey Kong Country 4, but later ended up being released separately as a demo before the physics overhaul that the project underwent. Some bugs can be seen, as this was still the initial version of the level, before undergoing adjustments.

Level Design and Concept: @Rangelukaz.

DKC4 Engine: Kalango, Leocore, Necrotoad.

Music: Rodrigo Boechat - Forest Of Memories.

#donkeykongcountry #donkeykong #fangame #snes
